title: Metabolic effects of carbon-plated running shoes: a systematic review and meta-analysis
publisher: Frontiers in Sports and Active Living
claims: Advanced footwear technology commonly combines compliant, resilient foam with a full-length carbon fiber plate that increases longitudinal bending stiffness.
Whether the plate itself produces metabolic benefits is debated.

The systematic review and meta-analysis found carbon-plated shoes associated with lower metabolic demand across running-economy measures, while individual responses and study limitations remain relevant.
The evidence does not establish that every runner will improve or that carbon-plated shoes prevent injury.
